items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Interviewer asks about Mike Luxembourg, Interviewee responds by discussing newspapers (Pittsburgh Courier, Chicago Defender) without mentioning any personal interaction or relationship with Mike Luxembourg.

ctx.x: What about newspapers? Is there any other newspapers that you were in touch with, especially where Mike Luxembourg?

The Pittsburgh Courier was the biggest thing then, the Chicago Defender. I think most of those papers, the Pittsburgh Courier is still going, but I think the Chicago Defender has been deleted years ago.
